name: OpenVPN Manager (Split Tunnel)
author: hemantHLIS
description: Manage NetworkManager OpenVPN profiles from the Omarchy bar while keeping credentials in the system keyring. Adds per-profile split-tunnel routing so only VPN resources use the tunnel.

barWidget.description: Import, connect, and disconnect OpenVPN profiles with keyring-backed credentials.

schema.label: OpenVPN configuration directory
schema.description: Directory containing .ovpn or .conf files. Files are imported into NetworkManager only when used.
